entities.name: Ümit Özdağ

entities.summary: Ümit Özdağ is a Turkish politician who returned to his position as the current leader of the Victory Party after being released from prison on 17 June 2025. Also, prior to his arrest, he had served as the leader of the Victory Party from 26 August 2021 to 21 January 2025.
